column1: # hf-rights.tsv — rights tier per source group (SKELETON: machine-guessed, REVIEW REQUIRED)
# Format: <path-prefix>\t<tier>   (longest prefix wins; trailing comments ignored)
#   original      — Gary Dean's own work or AI-generated content; full text publishable (CC BY 4.0)
#   public-domain — verified public-domain work AND translation; full text publishable
#   cc0           — dedicated to the public domain by the rights holder; full text publishable
#   cc-by         — Creative Commons Attribution; full text publishable with attribution
#   cc-by-nc      — Attribution-NonCommercial; NOT exported (release carries no NC terms)
#   cc-by-nc-nd   — Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives; NOT exported (see note below)
#   copyrighted   — third-party in-copyright (or unverified); catalogue metadata only, text NEVER exported
# Only original, public-domain, cc0 and cc-by are exportable; mk-hf-catalogue.sh
# holds that allowlist and decides text_included from it. Adding a tier name here
# does NOT make it exportable — the allowlist must be changed deliberately.
# ▲ NoDerivatives: extracted articles store narrative sections only, i.e. an
# abridgement. Distributing that is making a derivative, so ND material stays
# unexported even where non-commercial use would otherwise be fine.
# Defaults are conservative: everything unrecognised is marked copyrighted.
# Sub-paths may override their parent group (longest match wins), e.g. zenquotes/discourse.md below.
